description: KNaMo(OF₂)₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/nmm space group. K is bonded to four equivalent O and eight equivalent F atoms to form KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent MoO₂F₄ octahedra. All K-O bond lengths are 3.05 Å. All K-F bond lengths are 2.95 Å. Na is bonded to two O and four equivalent F atoms to form NaO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoO₂F₄ octahedra and faces with four equivalent KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. There is one shorter (2.30 Å) and one longer (2.54 Å) Na-O bond length. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.34 Å. Mo is bonded to two O and four equivalent F atoms to form MoO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra and faces with four equivalent KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. There is one shorter (1.77 Å) and one longer (1.85 Å) Mo-O bond length. All Mo-F bond lengths are 1.98 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Mo atom. F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Mo atom.
